{{Top|leg}}
'''Rampart Town''' was a quiet neighborhood in the upper levels of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jaller Obrim]]'s [[Jaller Obrim's residence|home]] was located. Obrim lived there in a multi-story apartment that appeared unremarkable from the outside, but kept out his dangerous enemies with elaborate security precautions.<ref name="tc">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
As the site of the home of a police officer, the name ''Rampart'' has unique meanings. Rampart is defined as a defensive wall. It is also the name a of a [[Wikipedia:LAPD Rampart Division|patrol division]] of the [[Wikipedia:Los Angeles Police Department|LAPD]].
